item.title: Humanoids at CES: The Rise of Physical AI
item.description: In today’s world, artificial intelligence is no longer confined to screens and software. We are witnessing a clear shift: AI is becoming Physical AI—intelligence that not only processes data, but perceives, decides, and acts in the real world. At the center of this transition are humanoid robots, machines designed with an increasingly human-like form and equipped with AI, sensors, hands, legs, and bodies able to interact naturally with human environments.
